digest.component_or_area: bridge state persistence and GET-rotation rotation tracking
propositions: Rotation state is migrated from inline fields in bindings.json to a dedicated .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar file while maintaining backward compatibility
New binaries write GET-rotation stamps to both get_rotation.json and legacy inline fields, reading the chronological maximum of both sources
The extracted get_rotation.py module preserves module-size policy by cohesively implementing load/canonicalize/effective-max/dual-write/atomic-save operations at an established call-graph seam
Rotation order is consistent across interleaved old-binary and new-binary pass sequences due to max(sidecar, legacy) read semantics
reconcile-check operations against pre-migration stores must not create get_rotation.json or modify git status
The sidecar file is staged and committed explicitly without git add -A, requiring membership in staging lists and basename checks
